data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: skip-review-check.sh consumes dso.workflow without legacy enforcement.strategy key (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
In `plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh`, replace the `enforcement.strategy=ci` short-circuit:

**Current code (lines ~94-102):**
```bash
_ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY=""
if [ "${DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW:-0}" != "1" ]; then
    if [ -x "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" ]; then
        _ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY="$("${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" enforcement.strategy 2>/dev/null || true)"
    fi
    if [ "$_ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY" = "ci" ]; then
        exit 0
    fi
fi
```

**New code:**
```bash
_DSO_WORKFLOW=""
if [ "${DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW:-0}" != "1" ]; then
    if [ -x "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" ]; then
        _DSO_WORKFLOW="$("${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || true)"
    fi
    if [ "$_DSO_WORKFLOW" = "ci-pr" ]; then
        exit 0
    fi
fi
```

Update the comment block above to reference `dso.workflow=ci-pr` instead of `enforcement.strategy=ci`.
Preserve DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW escape hatch (unchanged).
Preserve _PLUGIN_ROOT resolution (unchanged — already correct).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] skip-review-check.sh no longer reads enforcement.strategy via read-config.sh
  Verify: ! grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] skip-review-check.sh reads dso.workflow via read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW escape hatch preserved
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW' plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] Given dso.workflow=ci-pr fixture, reviewable file produces exit 0
  Verify: _C=$(mktemp) && echo 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' > "$_C" && result=$(echo 'app/src/main.py' | WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$_C" bash plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh 2>/dev/null; echo $?) && rm -f "$_C" && test "$result" = "0"
- [ ] RED markers removed from .test-index for skip-review tests
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_skip_review_check_dso_workflow_ci_pr' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement skip-review-check.sh: replace enforcement.strategy=ci short-circuit with dso.workflow=ci-pr check
